title: A security_invoker view over the same auto-updatable shape is not a write bypass

expect.note: the only real finding left: RLS is not FORCEd, so the table owner still sees and writes every row

fix: ALTER TABLE c_invoker_view_no_write.submissions FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. The view needs no fix — `security_invoker` is what the definer-view write path (case 27) is fixed *into*.
